Sprint 8: tools, permission engine, execution limits, approvals, action log

- Tool registry: get_time (low), list_memories (low), save_memory (medium),
  forget_memory (high); strict schemas, args validated in main, secrets refused
  before any approval
- Permission engine: kill switch > scope > switched off > high always asks >
  low runs > medium needs a standing permission or asks
- RunBudget enforces steps, time (approval waits excluded), tool calls and
  spend per typed request; 2 tasks at once; voice tool calls 30/min
- Agent loop for OpenAI (reasoning passed back, function_call_output) and
  Claude (tool_use -> tool_result); voice function calls relayed to main
- Approvals queue (2-min expiry, Stop all answers no), executor with re-check,
  tool_runs action log (migration 3), live events
- UI: approval cards, Activity list, waiting chip, action notes, Settings ->
  Permissions tool switches and "Save memories without asking"
- Tests: unit (tools, permissions, budget, agent loop, migration), Drizzle log
  tests, 2 e2e tests driving real approvals; docs updated
